name: matchday
description: Matchday — FIFA 2026 stadium intelligence: multilingual concierge, crowd flow analysis, and step-free wayfinding.
author: aatifaqua

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @matchday/api && npm run typecheck -w @matchday/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @matchday/core && npm run test -w @matchday/api && npm run test -w @matchday/web
scripts.coverage: npm run build:core && npm run coverage -w @matchday/core && npm run coverage -w @matchday/api && npm run coverage -w @matchday/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm run build
